name: AdaptTable
summary: Headless data table for React and Angular with adapters for Mantine, MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Radix, Base UI, shadcn/ui and unstyled HTML.
description: One headless table engine with styled adapters for the UI kit you already use. Client- or server-side data through a single TableSource contract, URL-synced state, filtering with drawer/popover UX and chips, sorting, pagination or infinite scroll, virtualization, column management, inline cell editing, row grouping, aggregation, pivot tables, formula and sparkline columns, CSV/XLSX/PDF export, an automatic mobile card layout, RTL/i18n with 19 locales, dark mode, and an optional provider-neutral AI binding. Layered @adapttable/* npm packages; docs hosted at adapttable.orwamahmoud.com.
contains: React adapters: Mantine, MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Radix, Base UI, shadcn/ui and unstyled HTML
Angular binding with native HTML and NG-ZORRO kits; experimental Vue 3.5 packages
URL-synced state, filters with drawer/popover UX and chips, global search
virtualization (10,000 rows mount 10 DOM rows), infinite scroll and pagination auto by device
row grouping, aggregation, pivot tables, formula columns, sparkline columns, saved views
CSV/XLSX/PDF export, i18n (19 locales), RTL, dark mode, accessible data tables with keyboard nav
22 layered @adapttable/* npm packages incl. CLI, server query parsing and an optional AI binding
